text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock E and Stock B at steep losses after holding them, so I should set clear reasons and review points for each position rather than let reluctance to admit a mistake prolong the decision.","I took gains in Stock A, Stock E, and Stock D, then later bought back into some stocks at higher prices; I should avoid selling just to lock in a gain and consider the longer-term outlook before acting.","My later purchases of Stock A and Stock D were followed by losses, reminding me to check valuation, evidence, and portfolio risk before buying instead of reacting to recent price moves."]}
